e: Two-year postdoc run jointly by QMUL's Centre for Geometry, Analysis and Gravitation and Centre for Theoretical Physics and Astronomy on the project 'Symmetries and Quantum Fields: Dualities, Algebras and Learning' (QFT, generalized symmetries, black holes, holography, de Sitter, quantum information, matrix models). Applicants must also complete the application on QMUL's own site.
n: Queen Mary University of London: Postdoctoral position in Theoretical Physics (Symmetries and Quantum Fields)
unv: Salary and visa terms not stated; funded by the same STFC consolidated grant as the existing QMUL amplitudes row but a separate posting.
